⚑

Welcome to your coast.

Make a city people want to call home.

1Connect the blocks. Draw roads from the existing streets. Homes, shops and workshops need a road connected to Town Hall.
2Build a neighborhood. Add homes for residents and shops or workshops for jobs. New people arrive each day when services are available.
3Look after your people. Power, water, sewage and garbage travel along your streets, up to each plant’s capacity. Watch the four gauges at the top. Parks, schools and clinics raise approval. Check a building to see what it needs.

Click to build. Drag to pan. Scroll to zoom · Right-drag to orbit. Hold Shift and drag to paint roads or buildings. Keys 1–9 select tools; Esc explores; Space pauses. Green arrows mark buildings ready to upgrade.

Higher taxes bring in more money. Rates above 9% reduce happiness by 4 points for every extra percentage point.

Demand for development

Service funding

100% is normal. Less funding lowers upkeep, coverage and plant output. 0% suspends the service. Up to 150% extends service radius; plants produce at most 120% of their rated capacity. Roads keep their connections at reduced funding.
